title: Still Early — Melbourne startup and scaleup research list
geographic_scope: Greater Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Regional Victoria is not automatically treated as Melbourne.
completeness: Non-exhaustive research list. This is not a census of all active Melbourne startups and is not a verified map-import dataset.

group_definitions.melbourne_location_evidence: A company, investor or accelerator source specifically identifies a Melbourne office, headquarters, facility, business address or team location. These are different types of evidence; read melbourne_relationship. This is not confirmation of operating status or an exact map pin.
group_definitions.melbourne_directory_listing: Listed in a public Melbourne directory. Current Melbourne presence, company identity, operating status and official website still require independent checks. Directory descriptions were not copied because some were inconsistent.
group_definitions.programme_lead: Named by a Melbourne university accelerator or entrepreneurship programme. Programme participation does not prove a current Melbourne office or headquarters. Research lead only.
group_definitions.established_or_acquired: Established businesses or entries needing ownership/status review. Keep separate from the early-stage startup filter; do not assume independence.

import_guidance: Compare with the existing Melbourne dataset before adding records. Match normalised names, aliases and official root domains; manually review ambiguous matches. The total here is not the number of new additions.
Start reviewing the location-evidence group, then directory candidates. Keep programme leads unpublished until current location and operating status are established.

A Melbourne team, registered address, postal address, clinic, facility, office and global headquarters are distinct. Preserve melbourne_relationship rather than labelling every record as Melbourne HQ.
Use company-owned contact, careers, about or legal pages to validate current identity and location. Check recent operating-status evidence and official registers where relevant.

No coordinates or logos were collected. Do not invent street addresses, geocode all companies to Melbourne CBD, or scatter random pins. A city-only listing needs a clearly labelled city-level presentation.

A non-null website may come from an accelerator or directory listing. It is an observed link, not a guarantee of current ownership, availability or identity. A null website means no sufficiently grounded official URL was included.
Funding stages and operating status are deliberately unconfirmed. Reclassify established, acquired, relocated or closed companies before publishing.
Programme and directory listings may be historical. Research date means sources were consulted on that date, not that every fact was freshly updated.
Current website/database was not modified. This file is a research and deduplication input for Claude Code.
